Hi! Let us solve this together. 

Look at the bottom numbers. We have a three and a six. 

How do we get from three to six? What do we multiply by?
Multiply by two. So 2/3 is 4/6. next: 2/9 + 4/9?

Good job! You got it right. 

Now we have a new sum. 

Look at the bottom numbers. They are both nine. 

When the bottom numbers are the same, we just add the top numbers. 

What is two plus four?
is 6/9 because bottom stays same and we add 2 and 4 on top next: 1/4 + 1/8?

Spot on! You are doing great. 

Now we have one-fourth plus one-eighth. 

Look at the bottom numbers. They are four and eight. They are not the same. 

Can you change the four into an eight? What do we multiply four by to get eight?

Not quite. We do not add the bottom numbers. 

We need the bottom numbers to match first. 

To change the four into an eight, we multiply by two. 

What is the top number, one, times two?
is 3/8 because one over four is two over eight plus one over eight makes three over eight
